'''Hunter D''' (Japanese: '''ハンター''' ''Hunter'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM120|The One That Didn't Get Away!]]''. He is a [[Pokémon hunter]].

With the help of his [[Hunter D's crew members|crew members]], he was able to {{status|poison}} a {{p|Kyogre}}. His {{p|Carvanha}}-shaped submarine was equipped with a tractor beam, which he used to pull Kyogre further out to sea. Upon realizing this, {{Ash}} and {{an|Lana}} worked together to stop them from hunting Kyogre. With the help of their Pokémon and Kyogre, they sent the hunter and his underlings flying. They eventually landed on a beach where [[Officer Jenny]] was relaxing.
